description: Fork of exp013 with out_proj capacity scaled UP via per-table dims (not tph): out_input_nap 8->10 (table_dim 256->1024, 4×) and out_output_nap 32->64 (2× more votes per table). Per-LUT bit count grows 8×. tph stays at [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024] (exp013 sizing). Total out_proj bits grow ~67M->537M bits. Simple LN+Linear unembedder (MLP didn't help in exp014). Tests whether deeper input mixing (table_dim=1024) + more output votes is the missing capacity dimension.
